description: A sine oscillator with three further sines added to it, each tuned as a harmonic interval above the first and given its own level.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves the pitch. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune instead.
The interval the first added sine is tuned to above the fundamental.
Level of the first added sine.
The interval the second added sine is tuned to.
Level of the second added sine.
The interval the third added sine is tuned to.
Level of the third added sine.
Constrains the intervals the added sines may take: up snaps them to octaves, middle to a major scale, down to a minor one.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the fundamental at one volt per octave; the added sines follow it.
Moves the pitch, by as much as the MOD knob allows.

outputs.text: The three added sines alone, with the fundamental left out.
The fundamental and the three added sines mixed together.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
